profile: fusion rule: In multi-class classification, the fusion rule is a decision rule that fuses C two-class classifiers together to determine the label assigned to a point, based on signed distance to decision boundary. In nonlinear feature engineering, one aims to tune the parameters of W to satisfy the fusion rule.
